title: Practice 3: пере-: across, and over to another place

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Он ___ (перевести / переводить) Гомера с греческого на английский.
exercises.why: **перевел** is the past tense (masculine) of **перевести** (to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **переводить**. past: он перевёл · она перевела́ · оно перевело́ · они перевели́. — Wiktionary, «перевести» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  Wiktionary's senses of **перевести**: to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch; to translate, to interpret [with с (s, + genitive) ‘from a language’ and на (na, + accusative) ‘into a language’]; to remit (money).  «The verbs "носить", "возить" and "водить" have basically the same prefixes as the verbs of motion we have studied previously with corresponding changes in meaning. However, many of the prefixed verbs have also secondary meanings, some of which are more important than the basic meanings.» — DLI, Lesson 79.  «переводить — перевести — to lead over; to transfer, to translate. Note the following meanings:.» — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: He translated Homer from the Greek into English.
exercises.context: The verbs "носить", "возить" and "водить" have basically the same prefixes as the verbs of motion we have studied previously with corresponding changes in meaning. (DLI, Lesson 79)

exercises.q: Пациента ___ (перевести / переводить) в кардиологическое отделение.
exercises.why: **перевели** is the past tense (plural) of **перевести** (to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch; to translate, to interpret [with с (s, + genitive) ‘from a language’ and на (na, + accusative) ‘into a language’]) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **переводить**. past: он перевёл · она перевела́ · оно перевело́ · они перевели́. — Wiktionary, «перевести» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**пере-** — Movement across, from one point to another; through Example: Утки переплыли реку. — The ducks swam across the river. Prepositional phrases: через + acc.; without preposition + acc.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «The prefix "пере-" implies the following meanings: a) Going across or over something. In this case the verb is commonly followed by the preposition через + Acc. However, sometimes this preposition is omitted and the verb takes a direct object: Мы перешли через улицу. Мы перешли улицу. — We crossed the street. b) Moving from one place to another. In this case the verb may be followed by any preposition indicating motion to or from a place: Мы переехали на другую квартиру. — moved to … Мы переехали из города в деревню. — moved from … to …» — DLI, Lesson 62.  «переводить — перевести — to lead over; to transfer, to translate. Note the following meanings:.» — DLI, Lesson 79.  Compare: «Я перевёл детей через дорогу.» (to lead over (across)) — DLI, Lesson 79. «Меня перевели в другой полк.» (to transfer) — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
